column1: ## Summary of the values used in this analysis
# RA: pulsar right ascension in degrees
# IntTime: the integration time used in a MeerKAT observation in seconds
# ExpPrecision: the expected precision to which this pulsar is measured in micro-seconds
# ASN_measured: a measured value of the spin noise amplitude used in this work (see SN_ref for references)
# gammaSN_measured: a measured value of the spin noise spectral index used in this work (see SN_ref for references)
# SN_ref: reference for the spin noise measurements used in the ASN_measured and gammaSN_measured (see reference key below)
# ASN_estimated: an estimated value for the spin noise amplitude which is used for pulsars which have no published measurements for spin noise available (see paper for details)
# gammaSN_estimated: an estimated value for the spin noise spectral index which is used for pulsars which have no published measurements for spin noise available (see paper for details)
# ADM_measured: a measured value of the dispersion measure noise used in this work (see DM_ref for references)
# gammaDM_measured: a measured value of the dispersion measure noise spectral index used in this work (see DM_ref for references)
# DM_ref: reference for the dispersion measure noise estimates used in the ADM_measured and gammaDM_measured columns (see reference key below)

# ADM_estimated: an estimated value for the dispersion measure noise amplitude which is used for pulsars which have no published measurements for dispersion measure noise available (see paper for details)

# gammaDM_estimated: an estimated value for the dispersion measure noise spectral index which is used for pulsars which have no published measurements for dispersion measure noise available (see paper for details)
# jittter_measured: a measured value of the jitter noise used in this work (see jitter_ref for references
# jitter_ref: reference for the jitter noise estimates used in jitter_measured (see references key below)
# jitter_estimated: an estimated value for the jitter noise measurement which is used for pulsars which have no published measurements for jitter noise available (see paper for details)
# references key (for columns SN_ref; DM_ref; jitter_ref)
